analyses.name: ジンズホールディングス
analyses.long_business_summary: JINS HOLDINGS Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the planning, manufacturing, sales, and import/export of eyewear in Japan and internationally. It also engages in agricultural work contracting and farm management activities. JINS HOLDINGS Inc. was formerly known as JINS Inc. and changed its name to JINS HOLDINGS Inc. in July 2019. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
